name: Nothing in This Room Is New

description.value:
Duration constant

You have seen every kind of thing that is about to happen, and seen most of them twice.

You are never surprised, never off-guard to anything you can perceive, and you automatically succeed at flat checks caused by concealment or being unable to see. Once per encounter, when a creature uses an ability against you for the first time ever, you may treat it as though you had already seen it used — every benefit you would have had the second time applies to the first.

cinderfall.incomplete: Never surprised/off-guard to anything perceived; auto-succeeds flat checks made to notice something from concealment; once/encounter, treats a foe's first-ever use of an ability against the caster as though already seen. The off-guard clause alone would ship unencoded (real precedent: pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/shared-class-feats/level-8/blind-fight.json, rules: []), but "auto-succeed a flat check" unconditionally has no confirmed real precedent, and "treat as already seen" needs a per-ability, per-instance memory with no rule-element analog anywhere in the engine -- the load-bearing clauses don't resolve, so the card nets INCOMPLETE.
